raw_response.subject: Clarification Request: EPR Certificate Verification and Site Coordinates
raw_response.opening_paragraph: We are writing to request clarification and supporting documentation regarding your registered facility and the Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) certificates issued. As part of our routine compliance review, we have identified a few areas where additional information is required to align our records.

items.heading: Consent Validity and Category Permitted under CTO
items.what_we_observed: During our review of the EPR certificate EPR-CERT/617488/202504, it appears that the certificate was issued outside the validity period of the Consent to Operate (CTO) or falls under a category not permitted by the current CTO.
items.what_we_request: Please provide a valid copy of the Consent to Operate (CTO) covering the period of this certificate, or clarification regarding the permitted categories under your current authorization.

items.heading: Facility Coordinates and Building Footprint
items.what_we_observed: Based on the registered coordinates provided for your facility, satellite imagery (seed-42/site/PWP-09.png) does not show an active building footprint within 150 meters of the specified location.
items.what_we_request: Please provide the correct GPS coordinates of your processing facility, along with recent photographs of the site exterior and interior to confirm the physical location of the operations.

raw_response.closing_paragraph: Please submit the requested clarifications and supporting documents within 15 days of this letter. We appreciate your cooperation in ensuring compliance and accuracy in our records. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to reach out.
